episodes.title: Lunacy & Lorcan
episodes.summary: When Lorcan the minotaur starts having visions and acting out, his human brother Charlie helps him get to the bottom of it.

episodes.title: Gateways & Gatherings
episodes.summary: The Elders are determined to stop Craignelder's greedy plans. The kids uncover a link to the past—with unexpected consequences.

episodes.title: Maps & Myths
episodes.summary: While the kids explore the ruins and its hidden dangers, Craignelder enlists his conflicted son to frame Lorcan in a devious plot.

episodes.title: Rage & Rams
episodes.summary: A close encounter with the Pooka leads the crew right to a mysterious door, bringing them closer to the answers they seek.

episodes.title: Minotaurs & Monsters
episodes.summary: To help Lorcan control his anger, George takes him on a martial arts retreat. Meanwhile, the others uncover their biggest lead yet.

episodes.title: Suspicion & Secrets
episodes.summary: When the kids discover the Pooka's true identity, they form a plan to catch him once and for all.

episodes.title: Answers & Amulets
episodes.summary: The Elders finally reveal their knowledge about Lorcan and his world, hoping to discourage him from ever going back.

episodes.title: Labyrinths & Lies
episodes.summary: The Pooka attempts to lure Lorcan back to the minotaur world with false promises, while the others try to find him before it's too late.

episodes.title: Siblings & Storms
episodes.summary: All seems lost, including Lorcan and the amulet, but the kids are determined to get him back—at any cost.

episodes.title: Fixers & Fighters
episodes.summary: When dark forces infiltrate Bryony Island, it's up to the kids to protect its residents and fulfill their destiny.
